THE BOOKS

The Emotional Intelligence Coach's Handbook

emotional intelligence educationWith group leadership

2018 · World Publishing Corporation

The Emotional Intelligence Coach's Handbook

How was Gaoemotional intelligencetrained?

Classroom teaching and game activities are used as a carrier to discuss emotions, needs, communication and choices, and also focus on how leaders can establish a supportive learning environment in the group.

Content introduction

This book puts emotional intelligence education into practical classroom situations. Activities not only help participants identify their own feelings, but also guide them to express their needs, understand the situations of others, and take responsibility for their own choices.

This book focuses on

  • Recognize emotions and body sensations, and differentiate between feelings, thoughts, and reactions.
  • Observe habitual interactions through communication exercises and try to express yourself more clearly.
  • Support learning for children, adults and educators through games and group activities.

Who should read it?

Suitable for teachers, group leaders, parents, and readers who want to systematically learn emotional intelligence activity design.
